result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide roadway with significantly faded crosswalk markings and no dedicated crossing signals or signage. A large vehicle parked near the intersection creates a visual obstruction, while the lack of traffic calming measures suggests a higher risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are extremely worn and barely visible to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white pickup truck is parked close to the crossing area, blocking the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street in the foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility for drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crossing to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Yield to Pedestrian' signs to alert drivers of the crossing location.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. The roadway pavement is in poor condition with significant cracking, and the environment is dominated by asphalt with no greenery or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: Pedestrians crossing the street have no designated or protected space, increasing the risk of conflict with vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Large cracks and uneven surfaces in the roadway and near the curb create trip hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and intersection center

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians must rely on vehicular traffic lights, which may not provide adequate clearance time or clear right-of-way indication.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the left

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and predictability.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: This intersection lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals, despite the presence of vehicle traffic lights. The roadway surface is in poor condition with extensive cracking, and the wide, undefined crossing area increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground intersection area

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Extensive cracking and potholes in the roadway create trip hazards and may cause unpredictable vehicle movements.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire foreground roadway surface

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The absence of walk/don't walk signals forces pedestrians to guess timing based on vehicle lights, which may not provide adequate crossing time.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by a large unpaved section of roadway and ongoing construction, creating significant trip hazards and mud. There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to navigate a degraded and unpredictable surface.

hazards.name: Unpaved Roadway Surface
hazards.description: A large portion of the intersection is dirt and mud, creating severe trip hazards and making the crossing inaccessible for those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and middle ground across the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: Despite the presence of a traffic signal, there are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection lacks walk/don't-walk signals, leaving pedestrians to guess when it is safe to cross based on vehicle signals.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the right

interventions.title: Roadway Paving and Restoration
interventions.description: Complete the paving of the intersection to provide a smooth, stable surface for both vehicles and pedestrians.
